title: fix: replace deprecated alias/import with comptime/std.
body:
## Summary
Fixes Mojo 0.26 deprecation warnings across all files:

**`alias` → `comptime`:**
- `brotli_decompress.mojo`: 2 constants
- `zlib_decompress.mojo`: 11 constants
- `zstd_decompress.mojo`: 4 constants
- `http_client.mojo`: 8 constants (`ERR_*`, `MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES`, `_HEX_CHARS`)
- `psl.mojo`: `_PSL`
- `test_client.mojo`: `BASE`, `HTTPS_BASE`, `PROXY_URL`

**Implicit stdlib import → `std.` qualified:**
- `zstd_decompress.mojo`: `from ffi` → `from std.ffi`, `from memory.unsafe_pointer` → `from std.memory.unsafe_pointer`

## Test plan
- [ ] 107/109 tests pass locally ✅ (2 pre-existing failures: brotli/zstd network tests hit 503 from external server — pre-existing, unrelated to this change)
- [ ] CI passes
